launcher.heading: Open a shell in {{name}}
launcher.body: You get a terminal inside the container. Nothing you type or see is recorded. TierPlan records that the session happened.
launcher.bodyNode: You get a terminal inside the container, on {{node}}. Nothing you type or see is recorded. TierPlan records that the session happened.

command.label: Command
command.helper: The command to run, for example /bin/zsh.

notRunning.heading: Start the container to open a shell
notRunning.body: A shell needs a running container.

idle.warning: This session closes in 1 minute because nothing has happened in it. Press any key to keep it open.

closed.idle_one: Session closed after {{count}} minute without activity.
closed.idle_other: Session closed after {{count}} minutes without activity.
closed.access_lost: Your access changed. This session was closed.
closed.ended_by_user: You ended this session from your list of open shells.

disconnected.heading: Disconnected
disconnected.body: The connection dropped, so the shell was closed.

error.failed: Couldn't open a shell. Try again.
error.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only (set on the host). Logs still work.
error.notRunning: Start the container to open a shell.
error.busy: This host's agent is serving as many logs and shells as it can. Close one and try again.
error.noShell: TierPlan couldn't find bash or sh in this container.

readOnly.heading: Shells are off on this host
readOnly.body: This host is read-only (set on the host). Logs still work.

refusal.ownContainer: TierPlan doesn't open shells in its own containers.

noShell.heading: No shell in this image
noShell.body: TierPlan couldn't find bash or sh in this container. If the image has one somewhere else, enter its path.

refusal.limit_one: You already have {{count}} shell open, which is the most allowed. Close one to open another.
refusal.limit_other: You already have {{count}} shells open, which is the most allowed. Close one to open another.
